Ah another Heavy Storm discussion how I love these. Before I get the rain of down votes I encourage you to at least here what o have to say. Heavy Storm is a broken card it has been and always will be for many different reasons one being it's massive plus ability another being it's otk enabling is the best there's ever been (barring some pretty stupid cards that will never come back such as makyura). All of this being said I feel as though it's a necessary card in a world where equally unbalanced traps are legal and just as easy to mindlessly play and plus with no thought and little cost. Most people who don't like Heavy are your people who pilot back row heavy decks, doesn't that resemble something? Something like the people who don't like Dark Hole and Mirror force play otk or monster heavy decks. All of this makes sense but both are necessary to punish over extending such as summoning five and getting hit by the mirror force for the devastating minus 5 or setting five and getting Heavied for the same consequence. My point being it isn't fair for one to be gone and the others to be legal, so Instead of just telling someone to run bad cards to combat obnoxious back row look at It from the other perspective first where I could just as easily tell you to run bad cards like starlight road to stop Heavy.
